During the occupation of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''records vault''' in the [[Sobrikarill Valley]], a section of the [[Gorinth Canyon]], served as the meeting place between [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], representing the [[Balmorran resistance]] and Director [[Fenn (Balmorran)|Fenn]], representative of Balmorran corporations.
